d:
Ash blonde hair, short and neatly styled with a side parting. Deep violet eyes with a calm, intellectual expression. Appears as a mature adult in late twenties. Slender build, wearing a white high-collared dress shirt, a navy blue waistcoat, and a matching navy blue coat draped over the shoulders. A small gold monocle hangs from a chain over the right eye.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
